scope: OSV lock-version matches checked against enabled Cargo features, direct callers and current maintainer advisories. No exploit against the application or a production endpoint was attempted.

triage.result: Excluded version false positive: current maintainer advisory affects >=0.11.0,<0.12.1. The selected0.10.4 is outside that range, despite the OSV match.
Excluded feature condition: the non-default brotli feature is absent from the selected graph. No affected Brotli decompressor is enabled.
Conditional dependency risk: no direct application Debug formatting of client session secrets was found. Not an established application secret leak.
Conditional ECH path: no ECH configuration was found in the application's reqwest client. Not an established application data leak.

Review remains open: selected AWS-LC features and an HTTPS client exist, but cache-downgrade exploitability was not demonstrated. Review/update to the maintainer's patched release rather than treating a version match as an exploit.

Not confirmed as a macOS application certificate bypass: reqwest0.13.5's default verifier uses rustls-platform-verifier0.7.1, whose Apple backend delegates chain evaluation to SecTrust. No app tls_certs_only/custom webpki chain setup was found. Other-platform paths and exploitability remain unverified; review patched dependency releases.

Informational unsoundness advisory: no direct application AsyncFd constructor use was found. Transitive call paths were not exhaustively proven safe; review/update to the patched release. No application use-after-free was demonstrated.

limitations: No claim that dependencies are free of vulnerabilities. Native prebuilt ONNX runtime, model, system frameworks and provider-account authorization were not covered by Cargo/NPM advisory scans. Cargo-audit was installed privately but execution was blocked by the command allowlist; no global allowlist changes or execution bypass were made. The first OSV client failed Python certificate verification; the successful retry used system curl with TLS verification enabled.
